title: 第1003章  师傅
content_zh:
宗主脸上笑容瞬间僵硬，心中惊呼出声，连忙朝着远处躲闪。
“噗！”
剑势划破胸膛，留下一道深刻剑痕，鲜血如柱，疯狂喷涌而出！
紧跟着，那道挥剑身影便犹如乌云一般消散！
苏烬生心如死灰，看来，今日是必死无疑了！
刚刚他所施展的乃是天阶高级武技，神游杀，可以在原地汇聚一道身影，发动攻势。
当初他在云家家主身上所获得的，只不过，一直未曾施展！
方才也是想要以此方式殊死一搏。
结果，却还是失败了！
最主要的是，他实力太弱，无法靠近宗主，不然的话，那道分身绝对能将宗主斩杀。
如今，只是在宗主身上留下一道深刻的剑痕而已，并不致命！
宗主一手捂着上伤口，一手取出疗伤丹药吞下，怒目圆瞪，心中烈火燃烧。
显然没有想到，已经到这个时候了，苏烬生竟然还有招式！
纵使是他，都险些丧命当场！
可恶！！
心中低沉一声后，手掌翻转，一柄利剑犹如长虹贯日一般，径直朝着那道狼狈身影杀去！
这一刻，苏烬生已然无半点反抗之力，随手一击，便可将之斩杀！
“不要！”
云雪撕开虚空，发现当下情况之后，便直接惊呼出声，同时，冲上前去。
想要为苏烬生挡下那道攻势！

然而，终归是距离太远，根本来不及！
苏烬生脑海也是告诉运转，想着应该如何脱身，然而，所有底牌尽出，未曾留手。
逃是逃不掉了！
也不会有人来救他了，因为他在这圣域中，没有什么朋友。
即便是有，也绝对不是神海宗宗主的对手。
这一次，恐怕是真的要丧命于此了。
原本他还想着，能够依靠穿梭虚空术成功逃离此地，谁曾想，那一手遮天的威力竟然如此强悍！
远超他的想象！
这个时候，全场诸多弟子以及那两位长老也从幻境中回过神来，一脸茫然地看着眼前情况。
“奇怪，刚才苏烬生不是都已经死了吗？如今怎么又活过来了？”
“是啊，刚才我们亲眼见到苏烬生已经丧命了，这是怎么回事？”
“难道说，刚才的一切都是幻境，这才是真实的？”
“无妨，如今苏烬生也已身负重伤，无再战之力，离死已经不远了。”
“的确，苏烬生这次是真的没有生还的可能了！”
他们很快便推断出刚才只是陷入环境之中而已，眼前这一切，才是真实的。
虽然宗主身上多了几分伤势，但是，终归还是获胜了！
这个隐患，即将被除掉！
大长老和二长老则是凝眸望着那道身影，心底有些兴奋，他们要看着苏烬生被斩杀当场！
剑气奔袭，转眼间便已杀至身前，即将洞穿头颅之时，一道白光涌现。
“砰！”

那道剑气堙灭，直接溃散当场！
紧跟着，一道中年男子缓缓降落，强悍气息迸发，笼罩全场！
“竟然敢如此对待我徒弟，我看你们赵家真是在找死！”
“师……师傅！”
苏烬生望着突然出现的身影，脸上满是震惊之色，他做梦也没有想到。
师傅竟然会出现在圣域之中，而且还是在这关键时刻！
这简直太让他意外了。
没错，来的人正是他的师傅，江尘！
下一刻，他便已经震惊在了原地，因为他发现，师傅的境界惊叹已达天王一重境！
记得上次见面之时，还是圣人境。
如今才刚过去不到一年的时间，竟然直接达到了天王境。
这速度，简直逆天！
“这……这是何方神圣，竟然能够如此轻易的挡下宗主所释放的攻势！”
“你没听人家刚刚说吗，人家那就是苏烬生的师傅！”
“天……天王一重境界，他师傅的实力竟然如此强悍！”
“真是不敢想象，海域上还有这等实力的强者，看来苏烬生今天在死不了了！”
“不止是苏烬生死不了了，我们神海宗恐怕也将不复存在了！”
诸多神海宗弟子望着那道身影，脸上满是不可思议之色！
原本以为苏烬生已经必死无疑了，谁曾想，其师傅竟然会在关键时刻出手！
而且，还是天王境强者！

有如此强悍的背景，放眼整个海域，怕是无人敢招惹半分！
眼下，局面扭转，已然不是他们放不放过苏烬生了，而是苏烬生放不放过他们了！
虚空中，大长老和二长老也是如遭雷击，呆滞当场。
他们做梦也不会想到，苏烬生竟然会有这个强悍的师傅。
早知如此，他们绝对不会与苏烬生为敌啊！
云雪见状心中也是暗自松了口气，也在此刻来到苏烬生身旁。
取出一枚疗伤丹药送入其口中，为其疗养伤势。
纵使作为道侣，她也从未听苏烬生提起过，还有一个天王境的师傅！
这是在太令人难以置信了。
饶是杀气腾腾的宗主，也在这一刻收敛几分，略微犹豫了下，还是收起自身强悍气息。
压制心中畏惧之色，言语肃穆出声道。
“这位前辈，你徒儿加入我宗门，却违反宗门规矩，杀同门，杀长老！”
“理应处死！”
江尘神色平静，弹指间，一滴玉山圣液送入苏烬生的口中。
冰冷双眸地望向那道身影，强悍威压席卷而去。
犹如洪水猛兽奔涌而去，直接将之吞噬，让其心中生不出半点反抗之力。
“我徒弟什么性格我知道，不灭你们，是想留给我徒弟日后自己灭杀你们！”
“你们就等待死亡降临吧！”
苏烬生感觉自己体内伤势飞速恢复，转眼便已达到巅峰。
体内灵气运转间，直接将云雪笼罩，朝着虚空飞驰而去。

双目凌厉地望着那道身影，直接离合出声到。
“海域赵家，我归来之日，就是你们覆灭之时！”
云雪心中暗自松了口气，脸上蛮是欣喜之色，原本以为已经必死无疑了。
谁曾想，苏烬生师傅竟然会在关键时刻出手，着实让她们意想不到。
全场所有弟子都被笼罩在恐惧之中，身上更是犹如背负大山一样，无法抬头。
只能眼睁睁地看着他们离开，根本生不出半点反抗之心。
毕竟，他们这些人，在天王境强者面前，也就只是蝼蚁罢了。
宗主心如死灰，面色阴沉到极致，纵使是他也不敢出手阻拦。
心中感觉天都塌了一样，有这样一个师傅相护。
苏烬生迟早都能将他们赵家覆灭。
除非他能够突破至天王一重境界，凭借自身天地法相，或许还能与之抗衡一番。
这是他们的唯一出路了。
当即，他便决定闭关修炼，不突破至天王一重境，绝不出关。
想到这里，身影闪烁间，便已消失不见！
content_en:
The smile on the sect master's face instantly froze, he exclaimed in his heart, and hurriedly dodged away.
"Poof!"
The sword cut through the chest, leaving a deep sword mark, and blood spurted out like a pillar!
Immediately afterwards, the sword-wielding figure dissipated like a dark cloud!
Su Jinsheng's heart was filled with despair. It seemed that he was going to die today!
What he just performed was an advanced heaven-level martial skill, Fugue Kill, which allowed him to gather a figure on the spot and launch an offensive.
What he had obtained from the head of the Yun family had never been used!
Just now he also wanted to fight to the death in this way.
In the end, it still failed!
The most important thing is that he is too weak to get close to the sect leader, otherwise, the clone will definitely kill the sect leader.
Now, it only left a deep sword mark on the sect leader's body, not fatal!
The sect leader covered the wound with one hand, took out the healing elixir with the other and swallowed it, his eyes wide with anger and the fire burning in his heart.
Obviously, he didn't expect that at this time, Su Jinsheng would still have moves!
Even he almost died on the spot!
hateful! !
After a deep cry in his heart, he turned his palm over, and a sharp sword was like a rainbow piercing the sun, heading straight towards that embarrassed figure!
At this moment, Su Jinsheng had no power to resist at all. He could kill him with just one strike!
"No!"
Yun Xue tore open the void and discovered the current situation. She screamed in surprise and rushed forward at the same time.
I want to block that attack for Su Jinsheng!
However, after all, it was too far away and it was too late!
Su Jinsheng's mind was also racing, thinking about how to escape. However, all the trump cards were used and he did not hold back.
There is no way to escape!
No one will come to save him, because he has no friends in this holy realm.
Even if there were, it would definitely not be a match for the leader of the Shenhai Sect.
This time, I'm afraid I'm really going to die here.
Originally, he thought that he could successfully escape from this place by relying on the void shuttle technique. Who would have thought that the power of that hand that covers the sky would be so powerful!
Far beyond his imagination!
At this time, many disciples in the audience and the two elders also came to their senses from the illusion, looking at the situation in front of them with blank expressions.
"Strange, wasn't Su Jinsheng dead just now? Why is he alive again now?"
"Yes, we just saw with our own eyes that Su Jinsheng died. What happened?"
"Could it be said that everything just now was an illusion and this is real?"
"It doesn't matter, now Su Jinsheng has been seriously injured and has no strength to fight anymore. He is not far from death."
"Indeed, Su Jinsheng really has no chance of surviving this time!"
They quickly concluded that they were just trapped in the environment, and that everything in front of them was real.
Although the sect leader was a little more injured, he still won after all!
This hidden danger will be eliminated soon!
The First Elder and the Second Elder stared at that figure, feeling a little excited in their hearts. They wanted to watch Su Jinsheng be beheaded on the spot!
The sword energy rushed towards him, and in the blink of an eye he was in front of him. When he was about to pierce his head, a ray of white light emerged.
"Bang!"
The sword energy was extinguished and collapsed on the spot!
Immediately afterwards, a middle-aged man descended slowly, his powerful aura bursting out and covering the entire audience!
"How dare you treat my apprentice like this? I think your Zhao family is really looking for death!"
"Master...master!"
Su Jinsheng looked at the sudden figure with a look of shock on his face. He had never imagined this in his dreams.
The master actually appears in the sanctuary, and at this critical moment!
This was such a surprise to him.
That's right, the person who came was none other than his master, Jiang Chen!
The next moment, he was already shocked, because he discovered that the master's state of wonder had reached the first level of the Heavenly King!
I remember that the last time we met, we were still in the saint realm.
It’s been less than a year now, actually reached the Heavenly King Realm directly.
This speed is simply incredible!
"This... who is this? He can actually block the attack released by the sect master so easily!"
"Didn't you hear what I just said? He is Su Jinsheng's master!"
"Heaven... the first level of the Heavenly King, his master's strength is so powerful!"
"I can't imagine that there are such powerful people in the sea. It seems that Su Jinsheng will not die today!"
"Not only is Su Jin dying, our Shenhai Sect may also cease to exist!"
Many Shenhai Sect disciples looked at that figure with incredible expressions on their faces!
I originally thought that Su Jinsheng was certain to die, but who would have thought that his master would take action at the critical moment!
Moreover, he is still a powerful person in the Heavenly King Realm!
With such a powerful background, looking at the entire sea area, I am afraid no one would dare to provoke him in the slightest!
Now, the situation has turned around. It is no longer whether they let Su Jinsheng go, but whether Su Jinsheng lets them go!
In the void, the first elder and the second elder were also stunned as if struck by lightning.
They never dreamed that Su Jinsheng would have such a powerful master.
If they had known this, they would never have become enemies with Su Jinsheng!
Yun Xue was secretly relieved when she saw this, and came to Su Jinsheng's side at this moment.
He took out a healing elixir and put it into his mouth to heal his injuries.
Even as a Taoist monk, she had never heard Su Jinsheng mention that there was a master at the Heavenly King Realm!
This is so unbelievable.
Even the murderous sect leader also restrained himself a little at this moment, hesitated a little, and then put away his powerful aura.
Suppressing the fear in his heart, he spoke solemnly.
"Senior, your disciple joined my sect, but violated the sect's rules and killed fellow disciples and elders!"
"Deserves to be executed!"
Jiang Chen looked calm, and with a snap of his fingers, a drop of Jade Mountain Holy Liquid was sent into Su Jinsheng's mouth.
Looking at that figure with cold eyes, powerful pressure swept away.
It was like a savage beast rushing away, swallowing it directly, leaving no resistance in its heart.
"I know my disciple's character. If I don't kill you, I want to leave it to my disciple to kill you himself in the future!"
"Just wait for death to come!"
Su Jinsheng felt that the injuries in his body were recovering rapidly, reaching their peak in the blink of an eye.
As the spiritual energy in the body circulates, it directly covers the clouds and snow, and flies towards the void.
Looking at that figure with sharp eyes, he immediately made a clutching sound.
"The Zhao family of Haiyu will be destroyed when I return!"
Yun Xue secretly breathed a sigh of relief, with a look of joy on her face. She originally thought she was certain to die.
Who would have thought that Master Su Jinsheng would take action at a critical moment, which really surprised them.
All the disciples in the room were shrouded in fear, and they felt like they were carrying a mountain on their backs, unable to raise their heads.
I could only watch them leave, unable to resist at all.
After all, these people are just ants in front of the powerful ones in the Heavenly King Realm.
The sect master's heart was filled with despair and his face was so gloomy that even he did not dare to stop him.
My heart felt like the sky was falling, and I had such a master to protect me.
Su Jinsheng will be able to destroy their Zhao family sooner or later.
Unless he can break through to the first level of the Heavenly King, he may still be able to compete with him by virtue of his own heaven and earth dharma.
This is their only way out.
Immediately, he decided to practice in seclusion and would never leave seclusion until he reached the first level of the Heavenly King.
Thinking of this, the figure disappeared in a blink of an eye!
